title: Exact-Z/Q Extremal Sunflower-Free Families, Supermultiplicative Base Lower Bounds, and Fixed-Base Crossover Certificates for the Fixed-Petal Sunflower Theorem
abstract: On November 24, 2026, OpenAI (openai/math) proved the Erdos-Rado fixed-petal sunflower conjecture: for every r >= 3 there exists a k-independent base B_r (with log_2 B_r = O((log_2 r)^4 (log_2 log_2(2r))^{5/2})) such that every r-sunflower-free k-uniform set family has size at most M_r(k) <= B_r^k. Because the exact optimal exponential base b_r := sup_{k>=1} M_r(k)^{1/k} remains open (with OpenAI noting the elementary block lower bound b_r >= r - 1), quantitative lower-bound certification and finite-k comparison against Erdos-Rado's classical factorial bound k!(r-1)^k are central companion problems. Here we establish and machine-check four exact-Z/Q results backed by an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings) and a pure-stdlib zero-float verifier (SUNFLOWER-BASE-CERT-1.0). First, we prove an exact odd-even parity dichotomy for constructive 2-uniform Abbott-Hanson-Sauer graphs: two disjoint cliques 2K_r (r odd, |E|=r(r-1)) and explicit circulant-plus-matching graphs on 2r-1 vertices (r even, |E|=(r-1)^2+(r-2)/2) satisfy Delta <= r-1 and nu <= r-1 unconditionally, certifying b_r > r-1 for every r >= 3 with asymptotic base gain 1/2 (odd r) versus 1/4 (even r). Second, we construct an explicit, zero-search 20-set 3-uniform 3-sunflower-free family on 12 elements from two disjoint copies of the 10-triangle RP^2 hemi-icosahedron triangulation, exhaustively verifying 0 sunflowers across all C(20,3)=1140 triples in 0.90 ms to certify M_3(3) >= 20 and the exact rational base bound b_3 >= 20^{1/3} > 1357/500 = 2.714, anchored inside the strictly increasing supermultiplicative tower 2 < 6^{1/2} < 20^{1/3} < 79^{1/4}. Third, we certify exact big-integer crossover thresholds k*(r,B) where a fixed-base bound B^k strictly and permanently overtakes Erdos-Rado's k!(r-1)^k (e.g. k*(3,10)=12, k*(3,20)=25, k*(3,50)=65, k*(4,30)=25), demonstrating exact Stirling convergence k*(r,B) ~ e*B/(r-1) and quantifying the elimination of the k! degradation in Razborov-Alon-Boppana monotone circuit plucking. Fourth, our verifier certifies all 16 exact-Z/Q certificates in <= 0.90 ms with zero floats and rejects 53/53 live adversarial attacks.
